queries.sql: SELECT key, length(value) AS value_bytes FROM relay_lifecycle ORDER BY key

interpretation.throughput: Observed client path including local proxy/network and browser finalization, not relay saturation throughput.
interpretation.delayedReceiver: 400 ms delay of WS2B consumption feedback, not OS bandwidth shaping.
interpretation.periodicCoverage: Incomplete. Missing samples are unknown, not zero. Multiple queries returned different subsets.
interpretation.memory: Sampled entire isolate memory, not true peak RSS or a per-object bound.
interpretation.logCpu: Integer millisecond invocation measurements are not a substitute for periodic CPU totals.
interpretation.dailyCapacity: No 24-hour test or validated daily byte quota.
interpretation.metricTimeScope: Namespace lifecycle windows include setup/cleanup; browser elapsed measures only the workload.
